INSERT INTO audit_ledger (
  event_type,
  entity_type,
  entity_id,
  payload,
  created_at
)
VALUES (
  'ultravox_{{$node["Parse Ultravox Data"].json.event_type}}',
  'voice_call',
  '{{$node["Parse Ultravox Data"].json.call_id}}',
  '{{JSON.stringify({
    event: $node["Parse Ultravox Data"].json.event_type,
    call_id: $node["Parse Ultravox Data"].json.call_id,
    transcript_length: $node["Parse Ultravox Data"].json.transcript.length,
    status: $node["Parse Ultravox Data"].json.call_status
  })}}'::jsonb,
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
